name: Kinoshita Kumiko
source:
A loli-esque girl who comes from the city to play.

She is your typical little sister type. She is high-spirited and a little sassy, but she also has a clumsy side.

She loves to wear frilly swimsuits.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=27394&gc=gc]getchu[/url]]
